formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj], (∀ (x4 : Fin x1) (x5 : x2.Walk x4 x4), x5.IsCycle → (5 : ℕ) ≤ x5.length) → x2.edgeFinset.Nonempty → ∀ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x2 x6 → PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x2 x6 → PEqualNP.TopForm.junk x2 x6 = ∅ → PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar x2 x6 = ∅
plain_statement: Let G have an edge and no cycle shorter than 5, and C a least circuit of AND and OR gates each reading exactly two earlier wires computing G's edge function, in top form (no AND gate true only where the function is lies inside another AND's cone). If C has no junk AND (an AND true somewhere the function is false), every edge of G is a cross pair of some top (an AND true only where the function is).
